name: E & D Plastics Inc
old_description: Furniture, Framing, Lighting, Art Enhancement, Commercial Work, Medical Supplies, Museum Cases, Pet Accessories, Restaurant Accoutrements, Wedding & Event Displays, Food Containers and more.
about:
E & D Plastics Inc has operated from Dallas, Texas for more than 35 years, establishing itself as a custom plastic fabrication shop. The company serves a broad clientele from its Texas location, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in custom plastic fabrication, acrylic fabrication, and plastic machining, producing items such as museum cases, furniture components, lighting accessories, frames, and risers. Work begins with plastic sheets, rods, and tubes that are cut, machined, and finished to customer specifications; the team can also translate sketches or photos into CAD drawings before production. Most projects are made-to-order, though a selection of lighting accessories, frames, and risers is kept in stock.

Customers include retailers, wholesalers, designers, artists, and homeowners across sectors such as furniture, framing, lighting, art enhancement, commercial work, medical supplies, museum cases, pet accessories, restaurant accoutrements, wedding and event displays, and food containers.

The company emphasizes that every project is handled by professional fabrication craftsmen, with attention to detail and quality that it says surpasses overseas or chain-store alternatives. All work is guaranteed, and the business highlights personal relationships and direct access to staff as key differentiators.
